review_scope: Resumed original-image visual candidate review only. No art edits, lifecycle actions, final approval or release authorization.
method: Each of the five original files per ID inspected individually with vision_analyze. Prior board observations were context only; no board substituted for an original.

status_meaning.pass: Bounded visual candidate pass only; separate historical holds remain effective.
status_meaning.needs-decision: Review completed but fidelity acceptance or additional attachment evidence needed; not automatically a proven mesh defect.

results.disposition_reason: Bounded visual candidate pass: required originals inspected, core identity retained, and no definite gross geometry or framing defect observed. Not final user approval.
observations: Pale rock ridges, green slopes and turquoise channel retain the promotional identity; blue-gray flowing striations, brass and irregular feet remain recognizable.

All four runtime originals show the complete object without clipping; open cavity and lid underside are readable. Green closed-lid reveal is also present in marketing, not a newly established closure failure.
finish_and_fidelity_differences: Runtime stone/body striations are more regular and flatter than promotional texture and may read as wood grain.
Green terrain is conspicuously faceted and water shallow; these are finish/form limitations, not proven mesh failure.
unresolved_visual_questions: Rear hinge contact and closed-seam fit cannot be certified from these front three-quarter stills.
visual_limitations: Static endpoint captures cannot prove motion clearance, topology, rear hinge attachment or hidden-face correctness.
Marketing is a closed promotional illustration, not exact-model or interior equivalence evidence.
Fine hardware and small captions are limited by on-screen object scale; mobile is emulated, not a physical-phone test.
Released front clasp is not evidence of a detached rear hinge; exterior lid ornament rotating out of view is not disappearance.
results.separate_hold: Full historical inventory hold retained, separate from this visual candidate pass; no archive inventory rerun or release clearance.
